# AIVis

AIVis checks whether a business is mentioned when AI search engines
(ChatGPT, Gemini) are asked about its category, scores the result from
0-100, and tracks the score over time.

## How it works

AIVis sends category-relevant questions (e.g. "who does emergency
plumbing in Rotterdam") through OpenAI's GPT-5 mini and Google's Gemini 3
Flash, both queried via Perplexity's grounded search API so answers
reflect live web results rather than each model's static training data.
It checks whether the business is mentioned, how it ranks relative to
named competitors, and how consistently that happens across repeated
prompts.

## Scoring

Score = round(100 * (timesRankedFirst + 0.4 * timesBeatenButMentioned) /
completedCalls), 0-100, or no score if every call failed. Higher means the
business shows up first more consistently; a null score means AIVis
couldn't get a usable answer from the models, not that the business
scored zero.

## Pricing

Free: 1 tracked company, 3 scans total, no credit card required.
Paid ("Pro"): unlimited companies and scans, single flat monthly price.
